entities.summary: Francesca Nunzi is an Italian actress. She graduated at the Laboratory of Performing Exercises under Gigi Proietti and is best known for films such as Tinto Brass' sex comedies, Cheeky and Monella. She has also starred in several TV shows including Il bello delle donne.
